kitDescription: Yan is a Fire rocket-launcher Supporter whose whole kit is team-wide buffing plus one burst nuke. Whenever any Full Burst begins, she grants all allies (including herself) +21.55% Charge Damage for 10 seconds, which pays off on her own and her allies' charged shots. Every time she fires a full-charge rocket — which is every shot she takes — she refreshes a 5-second +2.77% ATK and +1.33% Critical Rate buff on the whole team, so with her roughly 2-second fire cycle these small buffs stay up almost permanently. Her Burst I skill is a single hit dealing 348.73% of her final ATK to enemies in range, landing before the Full Burst window opens so it never gets the +50% Full Burst bonus. The burst also yanks normal enemies toward the center of its area for 2 seconds, a crowd-control pull that has no damage effect on the single test boss.

verdictRationale: Convergence is mechanical and real: the S5 blind suite runs 15 GREEN / 1 documented skip / 0 RED against the driver's shipped override with zero assertion-semantics changes, and the S6 blind override is semantically identical to the driver's on every line (the only diffs are encoding-shape equivalents the S2b spec pre-cleared: chargeCounter{count:1} vs shotFired for an always-full-charge RL, and explicit vs engine-default crit/noRange/noFb on the burst flatDamage). All four load-bearing lines are FAITHFUL with correct formula routing — chargeDamagePct in the charge bucket (not the multiplier stat), plain atkPct (not casterAtkPct), UNSCOPED critRatePct (the inverse scope trap, correctly avoided), and an FB-exempt burst-cast nuke matching the measured timing rule — and each is pinned by a discriminating counterfactual that provably diverges (burstCast re-trigger, FB gate, stacking, strip). The forced-movement line is a DOCUMENTED_GAP agreed by all three agents. Residuals for owner spot-check (none blocking): (1) the blind S6 ⚑ that yan's burst is modeled instant on cast while other roster RL burst nukes have measured flight delay — if popup footage ever shows her nuke landing inside the FB window, add delaySec and drop the noFb default (recipe: banner-to-popup frame read on a yan-focused recording); (2) the datamined cadence tuple (chargeFrames 90 / reloadFrames 141) is the standard scope-lock basis, unmeasured per-unit, which bounds how precisely the S2 5s-refresh uptime is known; (3) cross-family convergence here is stronger than the usual same-model caveat (driver Qwen, blinds Claude, judge Kimi), but the burst flight-time question is the one place every agent relied on convention rather than a yan-specific measurement.
